resources.string: Blocks Reels, Shorts, and infinite-scroll feeds.

Touchgrass uses the Accessibility service for one thing: to detect when you open a short-form feed (Reels, Shorts, TikTok, Spotlight) in the apps you ask it to block, and to send you back out.
What Touchgrass can see: • Which app is open, and only when that app is one you chose to block. • Screen elements within those apps, just long enough to detect a feed.
What Touchgrass cannot see: • Your messages, banking apps, keyboard input, photos, or any app you didn\'t add. • Nothing leaves your phone.
You can review and change which apps Touchgrass watches at any time, from inside the app.
